strategies.name: The traded portfolio (70% 60/40 + 30% trend)

holdout.detail: Sharpe 0.72 before 2020, 0.49 after (benchmark after 2020: 0.53). It kept 67% of its pre-2020 quality and reached 92% of the benchmark's.

benchmark.detail: Sharpe difference against a 60/40 mix: +0.01 (95% interval -0.08 to +0.11).

luck.detail: Its timing beat 91% of 200 copies with the same holdings shuffled in time.

multiple.detail: Counting 4 variants tried, the chance its pre-2020 Sharpe is more than luck: 99%.

stability.detail: Rank correlation of 4 variants before and after 2020: +1.00 (1 = same order, −1 = reversed).

lookahead.detail: Decisions recomputed on data cut at 4 past dates matched exactly.

costs.detail: At four times the trading costs it keeps 93% of its Sharpe (0.58).

concentration.detail: Without its best year (2008) its Sharpe advantage disappears (-0.04).

findings: Its edge over a 60/40 mix is within luck: the 95% interval runs from -0.08 to +0.11.
Its timing beat only 91% of shuffled copies of itself, so much of the result could come from what it owned, not when.
Its whole advantage comes from one year (2008).
